tenderSchedule.description: PROVIDING PROJECT MANAGEMENT CONSULTANCY (PMC) Services for the work of Improvement and Development of Roads, Drains and Culverts in Anekal Taluk, BDA Planning Area (Package 02)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and Conditions as per Tender Documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A) PMC (Project management Consultancy) Services should have worked satisfactorily completed Road, Drain, Culverts, Storm Water Drain, of an any gov project not less than 15.00 crores and above, Work order copy, Agreement, Completion certificate, Tender Indent No, Work done certificate

Consultants Must Have ( OWN or MOU) NABL/NACC accreditation Lab should have Min 75 parameters of Road and Building material testing scope of accreditation, compulsory Steel testing parameters Must having NABL/ NAAC/ ISO certified with in Bangalore only Institutions Certificate not Considered
Consultant should have ESIC & EPF Registration certificates with last 2 Years paid challan.
Consultant should have MSME, Form C, CSIR- Central Road Research Institute should be Registered and running office from past 3 years. Proof of certificate should be submitted
Consultant should have Certificate of Registration Under CSIR- Central Road Research Institute
Methodology and work plan, Task Assignment, Manning Schedule, PPT presentation will be uploaded and present
Qualification and Relevant Experience of the Key Professional Staff for the Assignment

Achieved at in 2 financial year a minimum annual turnover (in all classes PMC of Civil Engineering Consultation Works only) of Rs. 50.00 Lakhs in last Three years. along with UDIN No Achieved at in 2 financial year a minimum annual turnover completed Road, Drain, Culverts, Storm Water Drain,
